args.code:
import math
def control(obs):
    h=obs['hitch_deg']
    cam=obs.get('views',{}).get('camera')
    desired=0.0
    if cam:
        sides=[[],[]]
        th=math.radians(-h)
        for b,d in cam.get('walls',[]):
            a=math.radians(b)
            x=d*math.cos(a); y=d*math.sin(a)
            s=-x*math.cos(th)-y*math.sin(th)
            q=-x*math.sin(th)+y*math.cos(th)
            if 0.6<s<5.8 and abs(q)>0.6:
                sides[0 if q>0 else 1].append((s,q))
        estimates=[]
        for pts in sides:
            if len(pts)>=3:
                n=len(pts); sx=sum(p[0] for p in pts); sy=sum(p[1] for p in pts)
                den=sum(p[0]*p[0] for p in pts)-sx*sx/n
                slope=(sum(p[0]*p[1] for p in pts)-sx*sy/n)/max(0.1,den)
                estimates.append(sy/n+slope*(3.5-sx/n))
        if len(estimates)==2:
            center=sum(estimates)/2
            desired=max(-27,min(27,math.degrees(math.atan(5.2*center/12.25))))
    steer=max(-34,min(34,2.25*h-1.5*desired))
    return (steer,-0.75,-23)

args.code:
import math
rails={'left':[], 'right':[]}
last=None
start=None
def control(o):
 global last,start,rails
 t=o['t']; dt=o['dt']; h=o['hitch_deg']
 if start is None: start=t
 v=o['motion']['v_mps']; a=math.radians(o['steer_deg']); da=v*math.tan(a)/2.5*dt
 dx=v*dt*math.cos(da/2); dy=v*dt*math.sin(da/2)
 c=math.cos(da); s=math.sin(da)
 for side in rails:
  rails[side]=[(c*(x-dx)+s*(y-dy),-s*(x-dx)+c*(y-dy),tm) for x,y,tm in rails[side] if t-tm<9]
 for side in rails:
  view=o['views'].get(side+'_mirror')
  if not view: continue
  ox,oy=view['origin']; pts=[]
  for b,d in view['walls']:
   b=math.radians(b); x=ox+d*math.cos(b); y=oy+d*math.sin(b)
   if -20<x<-3 and ((side=='left' and 0.5<y<7) or (side=='right' and -7<y<-0.5)): pts.append((x,y,t))
  if len(pts)>3: rails[side]=pts
 def estimate(side,x):
  pts=rails[side]
  if len(pts)<3: return None
  pts=sorted(pts,key=lambda p:abs(p[0]-x))[:9]
  if min(abs(p[0]-x) for p in pts)>3: return None
  sw=sx=sy=sxx=sxy=0.0
  for px,py,tm in pts:
   z=px-x; w=1/(0.5+z*z); sw+=w; sx+=w*z; sy+=w*py; sxx+=w*z*z; sxy+=w*z*py
  den=sw*sxx-sx*sx
  return (sy*sxx-sx*sxy)/den if den>0.001 else sy/sw
 rear=o['rig']['trailer_rear']; look=4.5; x=rear[0]-look
 l=estimate('left',x); r=estimate('right',x)
 center=0.0
 if l is not None and r is not None: center=(l+r)/2
 elif l is not None: center=l-2.6
 elif r is not None: center=r+2.6
 desired=math.degrees(math.atan2(center-rear[1],look))
 desired=max(-24,min(24,desired))
 steer=max(-40,min(40,1.7*h-1.2*desired))
 gaze=64 if int((t-start)/2.5)%2==1 else -64
 return (steer,-0.7,gaze)

args.code:
import math
last_print=-20
def fit(p):
 n=len(p)
 if n<2:return None
 x=sum(a for a,b in p)/n;y=sum(b for a,b in p)/n
 den=sum((a-x)**2 for a,b in p)
 m=sum((a-x)*(b-y) for a,b in p)/max(.1,den)
 return y-m*x,m
def control(o):
 global last_print
 h=o['hitch_deg'];cam=o['views'].get('camera')
 steer=max(-42,min(42,2.3*h))
 if not cam:return steer,0,-41
 alpha=math.radians(o['rig']['trailer_heading_deg'])
 sides=[[],[]]
 for b,d in cam['walls']:
  q=math.radians(b)-alpha
  u=-d*math.cos(q);v=d*math.sin(q)
  if u>1 and abs(v)>1.4:sides[v>0].append((u,v))
 a=fit(sides[0]);b=fit(sides[1])
 speed=-.8
 if a and b:
  look=6.0
  y=((a[0]+a[1]*look)+(b[0]+b[1]*look))/2
  desired=math.degrees(math.atan(10.2*2*y/(look*look+y*y)))
  desired=max(-38,min(38,desired))
  steer=max(-42,min(42,2.1*(h-desired)+.38*h))
  if abs(y)>1.3 or abs(h)>35:
   speed=-.45
   wake('Bend detected; checking the trailer path.')
 else:
  speed=0
  wake('Camera cannot identify both rails.')
 if o['t']-last_print>10:
  print('t',round(o['t'],1),'h',round(h,1),'rails',a,b,'remaining',o['progress']['remaining'])
  last_print=o['t']
 return steer,speed,-41
